headline_marked: [[Google Calendar]] default view fixed by simple setting change
headline: Google Calendar default view fixed by simple setting change
summary: The default Schedule or Agenda view in Google Calendar can make it easy to overlook upcoming dates. Luckily, a simple tweak can ensure you never miss an important event again.
details: Forgetting important meetings or deadlines can be a thing of the past with a simple adjustment in Google Calendar. The app's default Schedule or Agenda view, while functional, can easily overwhelm users and cause crucial events to be overlooked, especially those further out.

The aggressive, color-coded layout of the default view can be a significant hindrance for those who prefer a more minimalist and comprehensive overview. This contrasts with alternatives like the Samsung Calendar app, which offers a cleaner interface and defaults to a full monthly view, providing a better at-a-glance experience.

Fortunately, Google Calendar remembers your preferred view once changed. By switching to the monthly or weekly view and closing the app, it will open to your chosen layout the next time, solving the issue of missed appointments.

For users who prefer an even more immediate overview, utilizing calendar widgets on your home screen is an excellent solution. You can display both the Schedule and month views simultaneously, ensuring that your upcoming events are always visible without needing to open the app.

Additionally, Pixel's 'At a Glance' widget can provide an extra layer of peace of mind by displaying active entries on your lock screen or home screen. Ensure your Work Profile events are enabled in the widget settings for a comprehensive view of all your commitments.
